title: Vestiaire multi-brand lead search
description: Search public Vestiaire listings for several brands and aggregate sellers that appear across those brands.

brands.title: Brands or search phrases
brands.description: Distinct brand names or public search phrases. Use 3-5 focused brands for the first run.

country.title: Market
country.description: Vestiaire market used for URLs and localized pricing.

maxItemsPerBrand.title: Maximum listings per brand
maxItemsPerBrand.description: Maximum public listing cards retained for each brand.

maxPagesPerBrand.title: Maximum pages per brand
maxPagesPerBrand.description: Safety cap for search pagination. Vestiaire typically returns up to 48 listings per page.

minBrandCount.title: Minimum distinct brands per seller
minBrandCount.description: Only output sellers represented in at least this many searched brands.

minListingsPerSeller.title: Minimum matching listings per seller
minListingsPerSeller.description: Only output sellers with at least this many matching listings in the sampled results.

includeProducts.title: Include normalized product rows
includeProducts.description: Also write the product evidence used to build leads to the default Dataset.

maxConcurrency.title: Browser concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel brand search pages. Keep between 1 and 3 to reduce blocking.

maxRequestRetries.title: Maximum retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum browser retries for a failed brand search.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Search response timeout
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds to wait for the public product-search response.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Standard Apify proxy settings. Residential proxy matching the selected market is recommended for stable cloud runs.
